targets.query: from(bucket:"bench") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement=="mysql" and r._field=="innodb_data_reads") |> derivative(unit:1s, nonNegative:true) |> keep(columns:["_time","_value","arm"])

from(bucket:"bench") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement=="mysql" and r._field=="innodb_data_writes") |> derivative(unit:1s, nonNegative:true) |> keep(columns:["_time","_value","arm"])

from(bucket:"bench") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement=="mysql" and r._field=="questions") |> derivative(unit:1s, nonNegative:true) |> keep(columns:["_time","_value","arm"])
from(bucket:"bench") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement=="mysql" and r._field=="threads_running") |> keep(columns:["_time","_value","arm"])

from(bucket:"bench") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement=="mysql" and r._field=="innodb_buffer_pool_reads") |> derivative(unit:1s, nonNegative:true) |> keep(columns:["_time","_value","arm"])

from(bucket:"bench") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement=="cpu" and r._field=="usage_idle" and r.host=="bench-vm") |> map(fn:(r)=> ({r with _value: 100.0 - r._value})) |> keep(columns:["_time","_value"])

from(bucket:"bench") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement=="net" and (r._field=="bytes_recv" or r._field=="bytes_sent") and r.host=="bench-vm" and r.interface!="lo") |> derivative(unit:1s, nonNegative:true) |> keep(columns:["_time","_value","_field"])
